name: leetx-squads
description: LeetX Squads browser extension - development tooling only (the extension itself ships without a build step).

scripts.test: node --test tests/unit.test.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-leetx "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs && node --test tests/e2e_full_suite.mjs"
scripts.lint: node --check scripts/background.js && node --check scripts/content.js && node --check scripts/firebase.js && node --check scripts/github.js && node --check scripts/leetcode.js && node --check scripts/core.js && node --check scripts/state.js && node --check popup/app.js
